release_gate_matrix.area: Datastore, queue, configuration, file, and key durability
release_gate_matrix.scope: Current database and files are selected as local/server state. Encryption, secrets, archival, deletion, and branch-isolation implementation/evidence remain incomplete.
release_gate_matrix.evidence: Container-level durability NOW EXECUTED AND PASSING; gate remains BLOCKED on its wider area. Durability run 35135793802 at commit 866396a (workflow 'Foundation datastore durability', check 104927987397, conclusion success, Docker 28.0.4) ran the real digest-pinned images - mariadb@sha256:2d2f4095530294735a857cfe22bb101e19b0849b416911c796ec4aa81b164a62 reporting 11.8.9-MariaDB-ubu2404-log and redis@sha256:75934ddb37bfaebe3b4082ba673cac39f66495244134f33dd0a502ce03cdcd36 reporting 8.6.6 standalone - with named volumes and explicit settings read back from the running servers (innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit=1, sync_binlog=1, log_bin=1; aof_enabled=1, appendfsync always, aof_last_write_status ok, rdb_last_bgsave_status ok). Against a captured pre-state of 25 committed rows with order-independent SUM(CRC32) checksum 51945241053, a Redis value digest and a 25-item queue digest, and an open uncommitted transaction held in a separate session, three real disruptions were executed and all state survived identically: docker restart; docker kill --signal=KILL with both containers observed exited/unhealthy and a cold start; and docker rm --force with new containers recreated from the SAME volume (mariadb 12e831ef68ca -> c081c5c03e39, redis c25b3f0c1c9e -> 0b72e4d5ec16). The binary log rotated once per server start (mariadb-bin.000001 -> 000005), independently proving four real restarts. The uncommitted transaction was never visible and was gone after every disruption. A negative control removed the volume and confirmed the table no longer exists, so survival is attributable to the volume rather than to luck. No mocks or simulated services were used. evidence/production-like-execution/hosted-durability-35135793802.json. STILL NOT closed, so this gate stays BLOCKED: that run captured no server-side InnoDB recovery log lines (fixed in commit 699ad7e, which now fails the run without them, but that stricter probe has not yet produced its own hosted PASS); host or region loss, storage-array failure, off-site replication, HA and failover are unproven; application-level workflow correctness after recovery is unproven; and the gate's own area also covers configuration, private/public file and encryption-key durability, which is not proven. THE CLAUSE 'the site encryption key is still generated and copied by the same ephemeral runner' IS SUPERSEDED BY EXECUTION: key custody run 35179445639 at commit 252345e issued both native keys (encryption_key and backup_encryption_key) on a separate custodian VM for two epochs, published only SHA-256 fingerprints plus one XOR share per channel to two separately named artifact channels, had an operating VM reconstruct and install them through frappe.installer.update_site_config, and had a third VM retrieve them again to decrypt a restored field and rotate both keys - with restore-without-key and restore-with-wrong-epoch-key both executed as required failures first, and no plaintext key written to any published artifact or left on the operator machine after destruction (custodian check 105068259227 10/10, operator check 105068842511 29/29, recovery check 105069423253 37 checks with 3 required failures). What remains unproven for this gate is DURABILITY of that custody rather than its existence: the channels live in GitHub Actions artifacts with a 14-day retention window, there is no versioned or off-site key store, no revocation, no custodian-side destruction and no custody audit log, the split is structural rather than a trust boundary because repository Actions secrets are inaccessible to this session's credential (HTTP 403, recorded as ENVIRONMENT-BLOCKED), and configuration, private file and public asset durability are still unexercised. The owner durability references required by D8-DURABLE-STATE (mariadb_durability_reference, redis_durability_reference, site_configuration_custody_reference, encryption_key_custody_reference, private_file_storage_reference, public_asset_storage_reference) remain NOT SELECTED and are not invented here: executing a custody MODEL is not an owner selection of a custody DESTINATION, so encryption_key_custody_reference and site_configuration_custody_reference stay NOT SELECTED. Prior startup-only evidence is retained as provenance: runner run 35122242676 started mariadb digest sha256:8b5f33ebd85d1775657e974ed10434128bb493c80e826ceaa54074fd1a92a112 to healthy in 5 polls with a START TRANSACTION/ROLLBACK count-0 result and redis sha256:75934ddb... PING/PONG; placement run 35122242728 ran start-mariadb, start-redis-queue and start-redis-cache for three real sites; the only prior restart probe was Gunicorn/RQ and explicitly excluded Redis and database restart. evidence/production-like-execution/execution-ledger.json
